第二世界摄影 | 现实遇见想象

将一张普通的现实世界照片，转化为一件富有创意的…

SECOND WORLD PHOTOGRAPHY | REALITY MEETS IMAGINATION

Transform an ordinary real-world photograph into a creative visual storytelling artwork where reality seamlessly transitions into a whimsical, hand-drawn second world.

COMPOSITION & STRUCTURE

Create a vertically composed artwork divided into two connected sections:

- Upper section: A highly realistic, photorealistic photograph of an everyday scene, such as a city street, modern building, library, park, bridge, landscape, or architectural location. Preserve authentic photography, natural lighting, realistic textures, accurate proportions, and rich environmental details.
- Lower section: Extend the scene into a warm ivory, lightly textured sketchbook-paper surface. Reimagine selected elements of the original photograph as delicate, minimalist black-ink illustrations, creating an imaginative continuation of the real-world environment.

THE SECOND WORLD CONCEPT

Introduce a small, charming hand-drawn human character interacting creatively with the photographed environment. The illustration should create a clever visual illusion, as though the person is painting, building, extending, repairing, or transforming something from the original photograph.

Examples include painting clouds onto a glass building, extending a real street with hand-drawn roads, transforming library stairs into enormous books, or allowing trees, architecture, and other elements to escape their photographic boundaries.

ARTISTIC STYLE

Combine professional architectural photography with delicate minimalist pen-and-ink doodles. Use thin black sketch lines, loose handwritten details, subtle imperfections, and warm cream paper textures. Maintain a sophisticated, editorial art direction with a playful surrealist touch.

STORYTELLING DETAILS

Add one short, poetic handwritten English sentence near the illustration, expressing the imaginative idea behind the scene. Keep the handwriting subtle, natural, and elegant.

IMPORTANT

The transition between photography and illustration must feel visually connected and conceptually meaningful. Avoid random doodles, excessive decorations, cartoon styling, or clutter. The result should feel like a photograph revealing a hidden imaginary world beneath reality.

Ultra-detailed, artistic, visually intelligent, photorealistic, minimalist, surreal storytelling photography, premium creative editorial aesthetic.

第二世界摄影 | 现实遇见想象

将一张普通的现实世界照片，转化为一件富有创意的视觉叙事艺术作品，让现实无缝过渡到一个奇趣的、手绘的第二世界。

构图与结构

创作一幅纵向构图的 artwork，分为两个彼此呼应的部分：

- 上半部分：一张高度写实、照片级真实的日常场景摄影，例如城市街道、现代建筑、图书馆、公园、桥梁、风景或建筑场所。保留真实摄影感、自然光线、真实纹理、准确比例以及丰富的环境细节。
- 下半部分：延伸场景至温暖象牙色、带轻微纹理的速写本纸面。将原照片中的部分元素重新想象为精致、极简的黑色墨线插画，形成对现实环境的想象性延续。

第二世界概念

加入一个小巧可爱的手绘人物角色，创造性地与照片环境互动。该插画应制造巧妙的视觉错觉，仿佛此人在绘制、搭建、延伸、修补或改造原照片中的某个元素。

示例包括：在玻璃建筑上绘制云朵、用手绘道路延伸真实街道、将图书馆台阶变成巨大的书本，或让树木、建筑及其他元素挣脱其照片的边界。

艺术风格

结合专业建筑摄影与精致极简的钢笔淡墨涂鸦。使用纤细的黑色素描线条、松散的手写细节、微妙的不完美，以及温暖的奶油色纸张质感。保持高级感、编辑风格的艺术指导，并带有俏皮的超现实意味。

叙事细节

在插画附近添加一句简短、富有诗意的英文手写句子，表达场景背后的想象理念。书写应细微、自然且优雅。

重要提示

摄影与插画之间的过渡必须在视觉上连贯、在概念上有意义。避免随意涂鸦、过度装饰、卡通化风格或杂乱元素。最终效果应像一张照片揭示出隐藏在现实之下的隐秘想象世界。

这尊华丽王座上布满错综复杂的金色钟表机械装置、抛光铜管、雕刻黄铜花饰、奢华的深红色天鹅绒软垫、发光琥珀灯，以及金色的麦当劳徽章。

微距摄影，极端特写人像。主角的面庞亲密地贴在一尘不染的展示柜厚重、布满冷凝水痕的玻璃上，而这座展示柜却突兀地矗立在一条破败潮湿的地铁隧道中央。主体佩戴着一款不可能存在的高级定制面具，由鲜活的白玫瑰与碎裂闪耀的施华洛世奇水晶制成，几乎如同直接移植 grafted 在皮肤之上。主角拥有极长的纺玻璃质银发，被塑造成坚硬、违背地心引力的湿感结构波浪，环绕并框住玻璃。高定时装编辑风格妆容呈现：光泽的碎玻璃感眼睑光泽、精确定位的真银箔如冻结的泪痕般划过面颊，以及晕染渐变的瘀紫色唇彩。粗野、直接的裸灯泡狗仔式闪光灯在玻璃面板上制造出刺眼而瞬间即逝的反射，在崩塌、布满碎屑的混凝土背景上投下剃刀般锐利的漆黑阴影。拍摄器材为 Hasselblad H6D-100c，120mm 微距镜头，f/2.8，浅景深。Kodak Portra 800 冲扫 +1，以强调粗粝的模拟胶片颗粒，捕捉皮肤毛孔、玻璃上的污渍、白色薄纱领口的细腻织纹，以及水晶面具刺眼的闪耀，与环境的粗砺质感形成强烈对比。

意图：创作一幅超现实的高级定制微距人像，将 pristine 奢华与原始的城市腐朽相对比，并采用粗野的狗仔闪光。
优先级：精细的面部细节、微距对焦、高反差直闪、真实的玻璃反射，以及鲜明的质感对比。
设备档案：高端中画幅微距摄影

- 布局：中心构图，由厚重玻璃柜的边缘与粗野主义混凝土背景框定
- 相机角度：平视，正对微距，隔着玻璃直接面对主体
- 倾斜/横滚角度：0

主体：
- 性别：女性
- 身份：被困于玻璃之中的高级定制游牧者
- 人群特征：超越年龄、非凡空灵却又粗砺
- 面部：对称，轮廓分明，微微贴压于玻璃，厚重妆容之下仍可见皮肤毛孔
- 头发：极长的纺玻璃质银发，塑造成坚硬、违背地心引力的湿感结构波浪
- 妆容：光泽的碎玻璃感眼睑光泽、精确置放、宛如冻结泪水的银箔、晕染渐变的瘀紫色唇彩
- 身体：仅可见锁骨与肩部，披覆于结构化白色薄纱之中
- 表情：强烈、坚毅却略带惊愕，双眼锁定刺眼的闪光
- 姿态：面庞亲密地贴于冰冷的玻璃上，静止不动，被亲密地框构

服装与配饰：
- 服装：
  - 束身衣式高领；硬挺的白色薄纱与精致花卉蕾丝；光学纯白；建筑感且僵硬
- 配饰：
  - 移植于面部的先锋假面面具；半透明白与刺眼银；鲜活白玫瑰、碎裂的施华洛世奇水晶与纺银丝；超现实高级定制

环境：
- 场景：置于废弃、布满碎屑的地下交通隧道中的一尘不染的玻璃展示柜内
- 表面：崩塌的混凝土、潮湿的污垢、厚重的污痕玻璃、娇嫩的花瓣、锋利的水晶
- 景深：极浅，将玻璃柜正后方粗粝的混凝土虚化为暗沉粗砺的形状
- 氛围：原始、粗砺，传达出潮湿混凝土的气味与相机闪光灯骤然的臭氧爆响
- 镜头互动：刺眼的眩光与高光在玻璃屏障和水晶面具上狂乱反弹

灯光：
- 主光：直接、裸灯泡狗仔式相机闪光，正对主体直射
- 补光：无，刻意保持 stark 与不留情面
- 轮廓光：来自玻璃罩内部的偶发高光反弹
- 阴影：粗粝、漆黑、剃刀般锐利的落影，投射在隧道墙壁上
- 色温：冷调、临床感 5500K 频闪，刺穿黑暗
- 传感器耀斑：直射闪光击中水晶碎片时产生的明显星芒光晕

相机：
- 镜头类型：微距定焦镜头
- 焦距：120mm
- 光圈：f/2.8
- 对焦：精准锁定水晶面具、面颊上的银箔，以及紧邻的玻璃冷凝水
- 传感器格式：中画幅数码 (Hasselblad H6D-100c)
- 透视变形：无，高光学压缩将暗背景拉近

后期处理：
- 色彩：高反差，将去饱和的污垢与刺眼的白银奢华形成对比
- 影调：强烈的明暗对照，刻意在水晶上制造过曝的极端高光
- 质感：厚重、原始的模拟胶片颗粒（冲扫 ISO）混合微观的数码锐度，以及极具触感的冷凝水
- 数码锐化：高频率分离，严格聚焦于玻璃划痕与精细的面具细节
- 色差：水晶与玻璃边缘的极端高光周围出现轻微色边

碎裂的华美倒影

微距摄影，极端特写人像。主角的面庞亲密地贴在一尘不染的展示柜厚重、布满冷凝水痕的玻璃上，而这座展示柜却突兀地矗立在一条破败潮湿的地铁隧道中央。主体佩戴着一款不可能存在的高级定制面具，由鲜活的白玫瑰与碎裂闪耀的施华洛世奇水晶制成，几乎如同直接移植 grafted 在皮肤之上。主角拥有极长的纺玻璃质银发，被塑造成坚硬、违背地心引力的湿感结构波浪，环绕并框住玻璃。高定时装编辑风格妆容呈现：光泽的碎玻璃感眼睑光泽、精确定位的真银箔如冻结的泪痕般划过面颊，以及晕染渐变的瘀紫色唇彩。粗野、直接的裸灯泡狗仔式闪光灯在玻璃面板上制造出刺眼而瞬间即逝的反射，在崩塌、布满碎屑的混凝土背景上投下剃刀般锐利的漆黑阴影。拍摄器材为 Hasselblad H6D-100c，120mm 微距镜头，f/2.8，浅景深。Kodak Portra 800 冲扫 +1，以强调粗粝的模拟胶片颗粒，捕捉皮肤毛孔、玻璃上的污渍、白色薄纱领口的细腻织纹，以及水晶面具刺眼的闪耀，与环境的粗砺质感形成强烈对比。

意图：创作一幅超现实的高级定制微距人像，将 pristine 奢华与原始的城市腐朽相对比，并采用粗野的狗仔闪光。
优先级：精细的面部细节、微距对焦、高反差直闪、真实的玻璃反射，以及鲜明的质感对比。
设备档案：高端中画幅微距摄影

画幅：
- 画幅比例：4:5
- 构图：极端特写微距人像，紧凑聚焦于面部、精细的面具与紧邻的玻璃屏障
- 布局：中心构图，由厚重玻璃柜的边缘与粗野主义混凝土背景框定
- 相机角度：平视，正对微距，隔着玻璃直接面对主体
- 倾斜/横滚角度：0

主体：
- 性别：女性
- 身份：被困于玻璃之中的高级定制游牧者
- 人群特征：超越年龄、非凡空灵却又粗砺
- 面部：对称，轮廓分明，微微贴压于玻璃，厚重妆容之下仍可见皮肤毛孔
- 头发：极长的纺玻璃质银发，塑造成坚硬、违背地心引力的湿感结构波浪
- 妆容：光泽的碎玻璃感眼睑光泽、精确置放、宛如冻结泪水的银箔、晕染渐变的瘀紫色唇彩
- 身体：仅可见锁骨与肩部，披覆于结构化白色薄纱之中
- 表情：强烈、坚毅却略带惊愕，双眼锁定刺眼的闪光
- 姿态：面庞亲密地贴于冰冷的玻璃上，静止不动，被亲密地框构

服装与配饰：
- 服装：
  - 束身衣式高领；硬挺的白色薄纱与精致花卉蕾丝；光学纯白；建筑感且僵硬
- 配饰：
  - 移植于面部的先锋假面面具；半透明白与刺眼银；鲜活白玫瑰、碎裂的施华洛世奇水晶与纺银丝；超现实高级定制

环境：
- 场景：置于废弃、布满碎屑的地下交通隧道中的一尘不染的玻璃展示柜内
- 表面：崩塌的混凝土、潮湿的污垢、厚重的污痕玻璃、娇嫩的花瓣、锋利的水晶
- 景深：极浅，将玻璃柜正后方粗粝的混凝土虚化为暗沉粗砺的形状
- 氛围：原始、粗砺，传达出潮湿混凝土的气味与相机闪光灯骤然的臭氧爆响
- 镜头互动：刺眼的眩光与高光在玻璃屏障和水晶面具上狂乱反弹

灯光：
- 主光：直接、裸灯泡狗仔式相机闪光，正对主体直射
- 补光：无，刻意保持 stark 与不留情面
- 轮廓光：来自玻璃罩内部的偶发高光反弹
- 阴影：粗粝、漆黑、剃刀般锐利的落影，投射在隧道墙壁上
- 色温：冷调、临床感 5500K 频闪，刺穿黑暗
- 传感器耀斑：直射闪光击中水晶碎片时产生的明显星芒光晕

相机：
- 镜头类型：微距定焦镜头
- 焦距：120mm
- 光圈：f/2.8
- 对焦：精准锁定水晶面具、面颊上的银箔，以及紧邻的玻璃冷凝水
- 传感器格式：中画幅数码 (Hasselblad H6D-100c)
- 透视变形：无，高光学压缩将暗背景拉近

后期处理：
- 色彩：高反差，将去饱和的污垢与刺眼的白银奢华形成对比
- 影调：强烈的明暗对照，刻意在水晶上制造过曝的极端高光
- 质感：厚重、原始的模拟胶片颗粒（冲扫 ISO）混合微观的数码锐度，以及极具触感的冷凝水
- 数码锐化：高频率分离，严格聚焦于玻璃划痕与精细的面具细节
- 色差：水晶与玻璃边缘的极端高光周围出现轻微色边

负面规格：
- neon
- cyberpunk
- short hair
- flat lighting
- wide-angle distortion
- cartoonish
- illustration
- smooth plastic skin
- empty background
- clean environment outside the glass
- softbox lighting

Top half|Real photography

The original image is preserved in its entirety, including the person, posture, composition, natural light, and color atmosphere, with only the color tone being refined, presenting a high-end art photography and independent publication quality. Design style

artistic warmth.

Color and Material

Extract the main color from the original image, combined with warm white, low-saturation color tones, and a small amount of contrast color. Add Risograph embossed printing particles, vintage paper texture, subtle offset printing inaccuracies, and scanning noise to create a refined physical print quality.

Layout Details

Only use a very small number of tiny numbers, coordinates, fine line markings, and color tickets as design elements, without using large headlines. All elements must be coordinated with the main visual, avoiding excessive information.

Final Result

A collector's-level poster for high-end design studios, art institutions, or independent publications. 根据上传的照片创作一张 3:4 竖版高端艺术海报，图像左右两半各占 50% 并严格处于相同位置，呈现“真实摄影 × 抽象几何艺术”的双层设计。

上半部分|真实摄影

完整保留原图，包括人物、姿态、构图、自然光与色彩氛围，仅对色调进行优化，呈现高端艺术摄影与独立出版级品质。背景可自然延展，但人物的面部特征、体型或原有细节

不得被改变。

下半部分|抽象视觉

从照片中提取图像，将人物的姿态、互动关系、场景轮廓与代表性元素转化为极简几何插画与抽象视觉符号。重新结构化色块、曲线、线条、网格与负空间，以保持原图的辨识度，但不直接复制照片。

设计风格

融合包豪斯、解构主义瑞士平面设计、后数字平面设计与日式艺术出版物美学。构图克制、比例精准、留白充足，将理性秩序与

艺术温度相结合。

色彩与材质

从原图中提取主色，结合暖白、低饱和色调与少量对比色。加入 Risograph 凸版印刷颗粒、旧纸张纹理、细微套印误差与扫描噪点，营造精致的实体印刷品质。

版面细节

仅使用极少量的微小数字、坐标、细线标记与色票作为设计元素，不使用大标题。所有元素须与主视觉协调，避免信息过量。

最终效果

面向高端设计工作室、艺术机构或独立出版物的收藏级海报。上半部分写实自然，下半部分抽象但能让人瞬间联想到原图概念。整体设计精致、极简且有格调，避免廉价商业插画与过度装饰

SEEDANCE 2.5 — BLADE SHERIFF vs. POLICE GREMLIN — THE GOLD VAULT

Duration: 30 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Style: photorealistic live-action action-thriller with a dry comic payoff. Realistic skin, leather, fur, gold, weight, and cinematic motion blur. Bright, luxurious golden lighting throughout.

Action movie camera work continues every 1 second.

Give every one-second interval a motivated cinematic camera movement. Adjacent intervals may continue the same shot; preserve geography and screen direction.

REFERENCE LOCK

Reference image 1 = BLADE SHERIFF only:
One 188 cm adult man, the exact reference face, swept-back brown hair, beard, black sunglasses, long dark leather trench coat, black shirt, tactical trousers, harness, and black leather engineer boots. One reference-matching revolver in his right-side holster. Maintain his identity and proportions throughout.

Reference image 2 = POLICE GREMLIN only:
Approximately 80 cm tall, enormous triangular ears, purple and pink fur, red eyes, uneven fangs, clawed hands and feet, a long furry tail, a blue police cap with red trim and gold badge, and the reference uniform shoulder patches/armbands. Preserve the reference anatomy and costume.

There are exactly SIX gremlins: one original sentry plus five identical-looking reinforcements. All six use reference image 2, remain approximately 80 cm tall, and retain separate bodies and consistent positions. No additional creatures.

Use both character sheets only for appearance. Do not show their layout, labels, diagrams, or backgrounds.

LOCATION AND CONTINUITY

One enormous bank vault, brightly illuminated by golden ceiling lights. Tall steel shelves packed with neatly stacked gold bars flank a spacious central aisle. A closed briefcase sits on a waist-high central pedestal. An already-open circular vault doorway is visible at the far end.

The original sentry patrols beside the pedestal, initially looking away from the hero's approach. Five reinforcements crouch out of sight behind low gold stacks at the shelf bases.

The hero descends behind the sentry's sightline, lands, disconnects from the rope, and approaches the briefcase. The rope stays behind him near the landing point.

Use shared frames to show the 188 cm hero towering over the 80 cm gremlins. The hero's right hand handles the revolver and later flicks the cap; his left hand carries the briefcase.

The gremlins' extreme sound sensitivity is a fictional creature trait. Their oversized ears reveal both their detection ability and their eventual weakness.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA

00–01:
Extreme macro on the original sentry's gigantic furry ear. It sharply TWITCHES at the very first instant. A rapid, precise push-in catches the flexing cartilage and individual hairs.

01–02:
Pull back in a low lateral arc to reveal the small sentry in the huge golden vault. Its long tail sways as it keeps watch beside the central pedestal.

02–03:
Crane and tilt toward an open ceiling vent behind the sentry. BLADE SHERIFF silently descends on a taut rope into the aisle.

03–04:
Track downward beside his descending body. His long leather coat hangs with realistic weight; the sentry remains turned away in the background.

04–05:
Push close to his sunglasses. Bright gold shelves and ceiling lights glide across the lenses. He remains intensely focused.

05–06:
Tilt down with him as both boots gently meet the floor. He disconnects from the rope and takes a silent, careful step toward the pedestal.

06–07:
Glide beside his extended right hand as it approaches the briefcase handle without touching it. A subjective heartbeat grows louder and faster.

07–08:
Rise into an extreme close-up of his brow above the sunglasses. One bead of sweat gathers, stretches, and detaches. The heartbeat intensifies.

08–09:
Track the single droplet down to the polished floor. It strikes with one unnaturally distinct, close-miked TIK. The heartbeat cuts off immediately.

09–10:
Whip-pan to the original sentry's ears. Both ears pivot precisely toward BLADE SHERIFF. The camera creeps around toward its newly alert eye.

10–11:
Continue the creeping arc as the sentry slowly turns toward him. Its alert expression becomes a mocking grin, exposing its uneven fangs.

11–12:
Slide laterally across the shelving gaps as FIVE reinforcements rise from crouches behind low gold stacks. Heads, caps, and huge ears emerge in an ominous coordinated reveal.

12–13:
Lift into a clear overhead view: exactly SIX gremlins form a ring around the single hero, with the pedestal just beyond his reach. Establish every attacker's position.

13–14:
Drop to gremlin height and sweep along the ring as all six bare their fangs and ROAR together. The hero stands at the center, dwarfing them.

14–15:
Pull rapidly into a wide, low view as all six crouch, extend their claws, and launch toward the hero simultaneously from their established positions.

15–16:
Enter brief slow motion. Orbit partway around the hero as all six attackers converge through the same physical space, claws leading, ears spread, tails trailing.

16–17:
Track tightly around his right side as he sweeps his coat backward and draws the revolver. The airborne gremlins remain visible beyond the moving coat; the draw is clear and continuous.

17–18:
Tilt sharply along his arm as he points the revolver STRAIGHT UP at the reinforced ceiling. The attackers close in. A tiny moment of near-silence precedes the shot.

18–19:
He fires EXACTLY ONE SHOT upward. Show one muzzle flash and one recoil, with a small distant ceiling impact. Snap to a wide view as a transparent, refractive pressure front expands from the gun through the golden room, bending reflections and lifting fine dust. Return to real-time motion with the report.

19–20:
Punch in on the original sentry as the sound reaches it. Its huge ears fold backward and ripple; its smug expression instantly turns to stunned panic. It grabs both ears and shrieks.

20–21:
Track across the other airborne attackers as they also cover their ears and lose coordination. Their claws stop reaching for the hero. The same single gunshot reverberates through the vault.

21–22:
Low lateral tracking follows the first three gremlins tumbling and sliding onto the floor. Gold bars rattle on their shelves; a few shift and clink, without a shelving collapse.

22–23:
Continue the motion into a wider view as the remaining three land and collapse in a staggered sequence. All six are now down, alive and dazed, clutching their ears. The hero remains upright.

23–24:
Push toward the hero as he calmly lowers the revolver and returns it to the same right-side holster. The original sentry still has its police cap.

24–25:
Track his LEFT hand lifting the closed briefcase cleanly by its handle from the pedestal. The last heavy echoes fade into small metallic rattles.

25–26:
Dolly backward in front of him as he strolls toward the already-open vault doorway, carrying the briefcase in his left hand. His coat swings with each measured step.

26–27:
Move to a low side angle. Beside his path, the original sentry weakly props up its upper body while remaining down on the floor, cap crooked. The hero briefly bends at the waist and knee, bringing his free right hand within natural reach.

27–28:
Tight tracking close-up of ONE casual right-finger flick against the cap brim. The cap pops off and spins away. He immediately straightens and continues walking.

28–29:
Follow the spinning cap down to the floor. It lands, the metal badge gives one tiny CLINK, and the cap settles beside the defeated sentry.

29–30:
Glide into a final close-up of the sentry's exposed ear, which reflexively twitches at that tiny clink. Rack focus to BLADE SHERIFF walking through the open vault doorway in the background, briefcase in hand. End on his unhurried departure and the sentry's humiliated reaction.

SOUND

No BGM, no rhythmic music, no musical stingers, no dialogue, no narration.

Use only environmental and action sound effects:
Faint ventilation, restrained leather movement, the rising subjective heartbeat, the single exaggerated sweat-drop impact, claws scraping metal, six creature roars, coat swish, revolver draw, ONE deep concussive gunshot, layered reflections of that SAME shot, nonverbal creature shrieks, falling bodies, rattling gold, the briefcase handle, measured boot steps, and the final cap-badge clink.

The heartbeat is a subjective tension effect, not a noise the guard hears. The sweat-drop impact is the detection trigger. Make the gunshot feel powerful through contrast and reverberation, without clipping or distortion.

CONSTRAINTS

Preserve the specified action order and the ear-weakness payoff. Slow motion is limited to the converging leap and the draw; keep the rest purposeful and moving.

The one bullet goes upward into the ceiling. The six gremlins are overwhelmed by the fictional sonic effect, not struck by bullets.

No blood, wounds, dismemberment, deaths, extra shots, lasers, magic beams, glowing energy rings, lightning, fireballs, room collapse, or additional combat moves.

No extra people or gremlins, changing scale, swapped costumes, fused bodies, duplicate heroes, floating weapons, teleporting props, or changing briefcases.

Keep the original sentry's cap on until the final finger flick.

No animation, illustration, comic rendering, subtitles, captions, title cards, added logos, or character-sheet text. Preserve the costume emblems visible in the reference.

SEEDANCE 2.5 — 刀锋警长 vs. 警察小恶魔 — 金库

时长：30 秒。
画幅比例：16:9。
风格：照片级真实实拍动作惊悚片，带有干巴巴的喜剧式收尾。真实的皮肤、皮革、毛发、黄金、重量感与电影感运动模糊。全片采用明亮、华丽的金色灯光。

动作片摄影机调度，每 1 秒持续推进。

为每一个一秒区间安排有动机的电影化摄影机运动。相邻区间可以延续同一镜头；保持空间地理关系与屏幕方向一致。

参考锁定

参考图 1 = 仅刀锋警长：
一名身高 188 cm 的成年男性，与参考图完全一致的面容、后梳棕色头发、胡须、黑色墨镜、长款深色皮质风衣、黑衬衫、战术裤、战术背带，以及黑色皮质工装靴。右侧枪套中放置一把与参考图一致的左轮手枪。全程保持其身份特征与身体比例。

参考图 2 = 仅警察小恶魔：
身高约 80 cm，巨大的三角形耳朵，紫色与粉色毛发，红色眼睛， uneven 不齐的獠牙，带爪的手脚，一条长毛茸茸的尾巴，一顶带红色镶边与金色徽章的蓝色警帽，以及参考图中制服上的肩章/臂章。保持参考图的解剖结构与服装。

共有六只小恶魔：一只原始哨兵加上一看完全相同的五只增援。六只都使用参考图 2，身高保持约 80 cm，彼此身体分离、位置一致。不得出现其他生物。

两张角色设定图仅用于外观参考。不得展示其排版、标签、示意图或背景。

场景与连续性

一座巨大的银行金库，由金色顶灯明亮照亮。高大的钢制货架上整齐堆满金条，夹着宽敞的中央通道。一个合上的公文箱放在齐腰高的中央基座上。远端可见一扇已经打开的圆形金库门。

原始哨兵在基座旁巡逻，最初背对主角的接近方向。五只增援蹲伏在货架底部低矮的金条堆后方，不在视线内。

主角在哨兵视线之外下降、落地、解开绳索并接近公文箱。绳子留在原处，靠近着陆点。

使用共享画面表现身高 188 cm 的主角俯视身高 80 cm 的小恶魔。主角的右手操作左轮手枪，之后弹飞警帽；左手提公文箱。

小恶魔极端敏锐的听觉是虚构生物特征。它们过大的耳朵既体现了侦测能力，也暴露了最终的弱点。

逐秒动作与摄影机

00–01：
极近微距拍摄原始哨兵那只巨大的毛茸茸的耳朵。它在最初一瞬间就猛烈抽动（TWITCHES）。一次快速精准的推进镜头捕捉到软骨弯折与单根毛发。

01–02：
以低位弧线拉远，揭示小小哨兵身处巨大金色金库之中。它在中央基座旁站岗，长尾巴左右摆动。

02–03：
升降机镜头并俯仰，移向哨兵身后敞开的天花板通风口。刀锋警长（BLADE SHERIFF）沿绷紧的绳索无声降入通道。

03–04：
沿他下降的身体向下跟拍。他的长皮质风衣垂坠出真实重量感；哨兵在背景中仍背对着。

04–05：
推近至他的墨镜。明亮金色货架与顶灯在镜片上滑过。他始终高度专注。

05–06：
随他一起下摇镜头，两只靴子轻柔落地。他解开绳索，向基座迈出无声而谨慎的一步。

06–07：
在他伸出的右手旁侧滑行，右手靠近公文箱提手但未触碰。主观心跳声越来越响、越来越快。

07–08：
上摇进入墨镜上方眉弓的极近特写。一滴汗珠凝结、拉长、脱落。心跳声加剧。

08–09：
跟随这滴汗珠下移至抛光地面。它撞击地面时发出一声异常清晰、近距离收音的「TIK」。心跳声立即中断。

09–10：
快速甩镜（whip-pan）至原始哨兵的耳朵。两只耳朵精准地转向刀锋警长。摄影机绕行逼近它刚警觉起来的眼睛。

延续绕行弧线，哨兵缓缓转向他。它警觉的表情变成嘲弄的咧嘴笑，露出不齐的獠牙。

11–12：
沿货架缝隙横移，五只增援从低矮金条堆后的蹲姿中起身。头、帽子与巨耳以阴森的协同方式依次显现。

12–13：
升镜至清晰的俯视图：恰好六只小恶魔在唯一的主角周围围成一圈，基座就在他伸手可及之处。确立每一位攻击者的位置。

13–14：
降至小恶魔高度，沿圆环横扫，六只同时龇出獠牙并一同咆哮（ROAR）。主角站在中央，体型完全压制它们。

迅速拉为低位广角，六只同时屈膝、伸出利爪，从既定位置一同朝主角扑来。

MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and confident personality.
Long black hair loosely tied into a messy side ponytail with a few loose strands around her face. Wearing a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a simple silver necklace.
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.
SETTING
A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon. Narrow concrete lanes, small houses, old walls, potted plants, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, laundry hanging outside homes, a tiny convenience store and children playing football in the street.
Everything should feel lived-in, ordinary and peaceful. No tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands or commercial activity.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.
Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, accidental zooms and natural camera imperfections.
No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting or polished commercial cinematography.
— OUTSIDE THE HOUSE
She steps outside carrying a small reusable shopping bag.
She locks the door, adjusts her messy ponytail and gives the camera a relaxed smile.
She starts walking down the narrow neighborhood lane.
A light summer breeze moves her hair naturally.
— MEETING THE SCHOOL CHILDREN
A few school children wearing backpacks come walking toward her from the opposite direction.
She recognizes them from the neighborhood.
She smiles, raises her hand and says:
“Hey, aren't you guys late?”
The children laugh and continue walking toward school.
One child briefly waves back at her.
She laughs and continues down the street.
— CHILDREN PLAYING FOOTBALL
A little farther down the lane, several neighborhood children are playing football in the street.
The ball rolls toward her and stops directly in front of her feet.
She looks down at the ball.
Then looks toward the children.
One child calls out:
“Noona! Kick it!”
She smiles.
She gently places one foot beside the ball.
She gives the football one playful kick back toward the children.
The ball rolls smoothly along the concrete toward them.
The children excitedly chase after it.
She laughs and continues walking.
The football remains with the children after she kicks it. It does not disappear, duplicate or suddenly return to her.
— QUIET WALK HOME
She continues walking toward the end of the lane.
She passes a small public water tap and stops briefly to rinse her hands.
She shakes the water from her fingers, fixes a loose strand of hair and looks toward the camera.
A bicycle passes behind her.
She smiles and starts walking again.
— FINAL MOMENT
She reaches the corner of the neighborhood.
The children are now playing football farther behind her.
She turns around and watches them for a moment.
One of the children notices the camera and waves.
She waves back.
She turns toward the camera with a small playful smile and says:
“See you tomorrow.”
She continues walking home.
The camera follows behind her as she disappears around the corner.
The recording abruptly cuts to black.
AUDIO
Natural location sound only: children shouting and laughing, football bouncing against concrete, footsteps, birds, summer insects, bicycle bells, distant scooters, neighborhood conversations, leaves moving in the breeze and subtle camera-handling noise.
No music. No narration. Only the two spoken lines specified above.

Feature one iconic landmark as the dominant subject.

Clean overlapping paper layers.

Intricately rolled and curled paper strips.
Fine spiral coils and delicate loops.
Precisely arranged parallel paper lines.

Beautifully sculpted architectural curves.
Realistic miniature paper craftsmanship.
Subtle natural shadows between individual paper pieces.

The quilling should be most detailed on the landmark, while the surrounding landscape remains clean and minimal.

Choose a completely different colour palette for every destination.

Use 4–6 coordinated colours inspired by the landmark’s architecture, culture and surroundings.

Landmark paper coils.
Background sun.
Geometric mountains.
Foreground landscape.
Supporting paper details.

Square or near-square central artwork.
Soft, pale neutral background.
Generous white space around the composition.
Elegant white mounting paper.

Realistic soft shadows.
Professional gallery-style presentation.
Front-facing, perfectly balanced composition.

Write the actual landmark name beneath the artwork.

[LANDMARK NAME]

Premium handmade paper-quilling artwork, minimalist architectural illustration, geometric landscape design, intricate paper sculpture, tactile cardstock texture and sophisticated gallery presentation.

构图四周留出充足白边。

专业的画廊级呈现方式。
